phase_history.details: Designed 13 new tests across 5 classes for chunk-11, extending existing test_tool_registry.py
12 tests failed (Dockerfile missing, config missing sections, registry missing get_strategy). 1 new test (denies_unlisted_tool) passed with old config. 14 existing tests pass.
27/27 tests passing in test_tool_registry.py. Fixed 2 downstream failures in test_server.py caused by config.json rewrite.
ruff format + ruff check + pyright (0 errors) passing. 298/298 PTC tests pass (no regressions).

deviations.description: Modified tests/ptc/test_server.py (not in scope.touched_files) to fix 2 tests broken by config.json rewrite
deviations.reason: Pre-existing tests hardcoded old config values (memory_mb=512, max_kernels=8, timeout_seconds=30, 15 tools). Config.json rewrite changed these to new design doc values (memory_mb=1024, max_containers=8, timeout_seconds=60, 16 tools including 'execute').
deviations.plan_gap: Plan didn't account for pre-existing tests in test_server.py that load config.json from disk
deviations.impact: Low - updated 2 assertions to match new config values, no behavioral change

decisions_made.decision: Kept existing conftest.py 'config' fixture unchanged (old schema without execute/tool_strategies)
decisions_made.reason: Existing tests in TestRolePermissions and TestToolListing depend on old fixture values. New tests use separate 'ptc_config' fixture that loads from actual config.json file.

decisions_made.decision: Preserved output_formats section in new config.json
decisions_made.reason: Not in design doc Component 10 but used by existing ToolRegistry.get_output_format() and tested in test_tool_registry.py

decisions_made.decision: get_strategy() raises KeyError for unknown tools
decisions_made.reason: Fail-fast on unknown tools rather than returning a default. Matches ToolDispatcher's expectation of valid strategy values.
